Parts.Description: Dark stone, raked gravel and wooden decks: the training grounds of the whole dojo.
Parts.Name: Dojo Grounds

Parts.Description: A three-tier pagoda dojo with dark walls and red doorposts. The Ninja Shiba trains inside!
Parts.Name: Main Dojo

Parts.Description: A tall red torii gate that spans the walkway at the entrance of the dojo.
Parts.Name: Red Gate

Parts.Description: Three straw dummies on a post that wait to be bonked with a mean headband.
Parts.Name: Training Dummies

Parts.Description: Four stone lanterns with a warm light that guard the doorstep of the dojo.
Parts.Name: Stone Lanterns

Parts.Description: Raked sand in a stone frame, three round rocks and a tiny pine tree.
Parts.Name: Zen Garden

Parts.Description: Fourteen tall green bamboo stalks that rustle when a ninja sneaks by.
Parts.Name: Bamboo Grove

Parts.Description: Three cherry trees in full pink bloom with a carpet of petals below.
Parts.Name: Cherry Trees

Parts.Description: A wooden rack with shiny katanas, ready for a surprise attack.
Parts.Name: Katana Rack

Parts.Description: Three tall red banners with a white moon fluttering behind the dojo.
Parts.Name: War Banners

Parts.Description: A stone-rimmed pond with lily pads and two fat orange koi.
Parts.Name: Koi Pond

Parts.Description: A tiny open tea house with a low table, two cushions and a hip roof.
Parts.Name: Tea House

Parts.Description: A tall wooden watchtower with a lookout nest and a two-tier roof.
Parts.Name: Ninja Watchtower

Parts.Description: A giant war drum on a wooden stand with two mallets. Boom!
Parts.Name: Taiko Drum

Parts.Description: A red wooden bridge that arches over the koi pond.
Parts.Name: Arched Bridge

Parts.Description: A climbing wall, a balance beam, jumping stumps and a pull-up bar for sneaky training.
Parts.Name: Obstacle Course

Parts.Description: Three round straw targets with red rings and golden bullseyes.
Parts.Name: Shuriken Targets

Parts.Description: A carved totem pole with two giant steel shuriken, a real eye-catcher.
Parts.Name: Shuriken Totem

Parts.Description: A stone Shiba with a red headband sits proudly on its plinth.
Parts.Name: Ninja Shiba Statue

Parts.Description: A huge glowing-white moon hangs between two red pillars: the pride of every ninja.
Parts.Name: Giant Moon
